reviewer: Claude Cowork multi-engine extension (S329 lane A, QUESTION_DIVERSITY_AND_TRANSFER Q2)
rationale: Added step ch2 (unitRuler: object 3‒12 on an inch ruler = 9 units) as a new challenge, so the assessed sequence now reconciles the lesson's estimate-only mcq/matchPairs surfaces with an actual manipulable measurement — closing the loop c3 promises ('if you measure and get an answer wildly different from your estimate, it's worth checking your work') but the lesson never delivered on. unitRuler is the exact engine mmt-01-01/01-02/01-03 (the prerequisite chapter) already teach, reused rather than invented; ch2's prompt explicitly calls back to the lesson's own 9-inch book estimate from i1/c1. Hand-verified by executing the app's own evaluate(): the correct submission {zeroAligned:true,unitSize:1,spacing:'exact',placements:9} grades correct with the 12−3=9 feedback; all 5 wrong paths (misaligned zero, gap/overlap, wrong unit size, end-mark-only misconception, sum misconception) grade incorrect with their authored diagnoses — see probe output in S329_QDIVERSITY_Q2.md. Also executed contrastScore/transferScore (scripts/audit/flagship-representation.mjs) directly against the edited file: d.contrast 0→2, d.transfer 0→3 (ch2's widget.type differs from every same-conceptTag check's type, so transfer credit is full, not partial).
